paragraphs.en: Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 让您轻松、快速地构建精美的应用，覆盖移动端及更多平台

paragraphs.en: Flutter is Google's SDK for crafting beautiful, fast user experiences for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. Flutter works with existing code, is used by developers and organizations around the world, and is free and open source.
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 是 Google 的软件开发工具包（SDK），可通过单一代码库为移动、Web 和桌面平台打造美观、快速的用户体验。 Flutter 可与现有代码协同工作，被世界各地的开发者和组织所使用，并且是免费的开源项目。

sents.en: Flutter is Google's SDK for crafting beautiful, fast user experiences for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase.
sents.zh: Flutter 是 Google 的软件开发工具包（SDK），可通过单一代码库为移动、Web 和桌面平台打造美观、快速的用户体验。

sents.en: Flutter works with existing code, is used by developers and organizations around the world, and is free and open source.
sents.zh: Flutter 可与现有代码协同工作，被世界各地的开发者和组织所使用，并且是免费的开源项目。

paragraphs.en: For release and other announcements, join the flutter-announce mailing list. Our documentation also tracks breaking changes across releases.
paragraphs.zh: 若要获取版本发布及其他公告，请加入 flutter-announce 邮件列表。 我们的文档还会跟踪各版本之间的破坏性变更。

sents.en: For release and other announcements, join the flutter-announce mailing list.
sents.zh: 若要获取版本发布及其他公告，请加入 flutter-announce 邮件列表。

sents.en: Our documentation also tracks breaking changes across releases.
sents.zh: 我们的文档还会跟踪各版本之间的破坏性变更。

paragraphs.en: The Flutter tool may occasionally download resources from Google servers. By downloading or using the Flutter SDK, you agree to the Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 工具可能会不时从 Google 服务器下载资源。 下载或使用 Flutter SDK 即表示您同意 Google 服务条款：https://policies.google.com/terms

sents.en: The Flutter tool may occasionally download resources from Google servers.
sents.zh: Flutter 工具可能会不时从 Google 服务器下载资源。

sents.en: By downloading or using the Flutter SDK, you agree to the Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
sents.zh: 下载或使用 Flutter SDK 即表示您同意 Google 服务条款：https://policies.google.com/terms

paragraphs.en: For example, when installed from GitHub (as opposed to from a prepackaged archive), the Flutter tool will download the Dart SDK from Google servers immediately when first run, as it is used to execute the flutter tool itself. This will also occur when Flutter is upgraded (e.g. by running the flutter upgrade command).
paragraphs.zh: 例如，当从 GitHub 安装（而非从预打包的压缩包安装）时，Flutter 工具在首次运行时会立即从 Google 服务器下载 Dart SDK，因为它被用于执行 flutter 工具本身。 在升级 Flutter 时（例如通过运行 flutter upgrade 命令）也会发生这种情况。

sents.en: For example, when installed from GitHub (as opposed to from a prepackaged archive), the Flutter tool will download the Dart SDK from Google servers immediately when first run, as it is used to execute the flutter tool itself.
sents.zh: 例如，当从 GitHub 安装（而非从预打包的压缩包安装）时，Flutter 工具在首次运行时会立即从 Google 服务器下载 Dart SDK，因为它被用于执行 flutter 工具本身。

sents.en: This will also occur when Flutter is upgraded (e.g. by running the flutter upgrade command).
sents.zh: 在升级 Flutter 时（例如通过运行 flutter upgrade 命令）也会发生这种情况。

paragraphs.en: We think Flutter will help you create beautiful, fast apps, with a productive, extensible and open development model, whether you're targeting iOS or Android, web, Windows, macOS, Linux or embedding it as the UI toolkit for a platform of your choice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为 Flutter 将帮助你创建美观、快速的应用，同时享有高效、可扩展且开放的开发模式——无论你的目标是 iOS 还是 Android、Web、Windows、macOS、Linux，或是将其作为你自选平台的 UI 工具包进行嵌入。

paragraphs.en: We want to enable designers to deliver their full creative vision without being forced to water it down due to limitations of the underlying framework. Flutter's layered architecture gives you control over every pixel on the screen and its powerful compositing capabilities let you overlay and animate graphics, video, text, and controls without limitation. Flutter includes a full set of widgets that deliver pixel-perfect experiences whether you're building for iOS ( Cupertino ) or other platforms ( Material ), along with support for customizing or creating entirely new visual components.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望让设计师能够完整实现他们的创意构想，而不必因底层框架的限制而被迫将其打折扣。 Flutter 的分层架构让你可以控制屏幕上的每一个像素，其强大的合成能力让你能够毫无限制地叠加图形、视频、文本和控件并为其添加动画。 Flutter 提供了一整套组件，无论你是为 iOS（Cupertino）还是其他平台（Material）构建应用，都能实现像素级完美的体验，同时还支持自定义或创建全新的视觉组件。

sents.en: We want to enable designers to deliver their full creative vision without being forced to water it down due to limitations of the underlying framework.
sents.zh: 我们希望让设计师能够完整实现他们的创意构想，而不必因底层框架的限制而被迫将其打折扣。

sents.en: Flutter's layered architecture gives you control over every pixel on the screen and its powerful compositing capabilities let you overlay and animate graphics, video, text, and controls without limitation.
sents.zh: Flutter 的分层架构让你可以控制屏幕上的每一个像素，其强大的合成能力让你能够毫无限制地叠加图形、视频、文本和控件并为其添加动画。

sents.en: Flutter includes a full set of widgets that deliver pixel-perfect experiences whether you're building for iOS ( Cupertino ) or other platforms ( Material ), along with support for customizing or creating entirely new visual components.
sents.zh: Flutter 提供了一整套组件，无论你是为 iOS（Cupertino）还是其他平台（Material）构建应用，都能实现像素级完美的体验，同时还支持自定义或创建全新的视觉组件。

paragraphs.en: Flutter is fast. It's powered by hardware-accelerated 2D graphics libraries like Skia (which underpins Chrome and Android) and Impeller . We architected Flutter to support glitch-free, jank-free graphics at the native speed of your device.
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 速度很快。 它由硬件加速的 2D 图形库提供支持，例如 Skia（Chrome 和 Android 的底层图形库）和 Impeller。 我们对 Flutter 进行了架构设计，使其能够以设备的原生速度呈现流畅、无卡顿的图形。

sents.en: It's powered by hardware-accelerated 2D graphics libraries like Skia (which underpins Chrome and Android) and Impeller .
sents.zh: 它由硬件加速的 2D 图形库提供支持，例如 Skia（Chrome 和 Android 的底层图形库）和 Impeller。

sents.en: We architected Flutter to support glitch-free, jank-free graphics at the native speed of your device.
sents.zh: 我们对 Flutter 进行了架构设计，使其能够以设备的原生速度呈现流畅、无卡顿的图形。

paragraphs.en: Flutter code is powered by the world-class Dart programming language , which enables compilation to 32-bit and 64-bit ARM machine code for iOS and Android, JavaScript and WebAssembly for the web, as well as Intel x64 and ARM for desktop devices.
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 代码由世界级的 Dart 编程语言驱动，该语言可编译为适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 32 位和 64 位 ARM 机器码、适用于网页的 JavaScript 和 WebAssembly，以及适用于桌面设备的 Intel x64 和 ARM 机器码。

paragraphs.en: Flutter offers stateful hot reload , allowing you to make changes to your code and see the results instantly without restarting your app or losing its state.
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 提供有状态的热重载（stateful hot reload），让你可以修改代码并立即看到结果，而无需重启应用或丢失其状态。

paragraphs.en: Flutter works with any development tool (or none at all), and also includes editor plug-ins for both Visual Studio Code and IntelliJ / Android Studio . Flutter provides tens of thousands of packages to speed your development, regardless of your target platform. And accessing other native code is easy, with support for both FFI ( on Android , on iOS , on macOS , on Linux , and on Windows ) as well as platform-specific APIs .
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 可以与任何开发工具（或完全不使用工具）配合使用，并且还为 Visual Studio Code 和 IntelliJ / Android Studio 提供了编辑器插件。 Flutter 提供了数以万计的软件包来加速你的开发，无论你的目标平台是什么。 访问其他原生代码也很容易，既支持 FFI（在 Android、iOS、macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上），也支持特定于平台的 API。

sents.en: Flutter works with any development tool (or none at all), and also includes editor plug-ins for both Visual Studio Code and IntelliJ / Android Studio .
sents.zh: Flutter 可以与任何开发工具（或完全不使用工具）配合使用，并且还为 Visual Studio Code 和 IntelliJ / Android Studio 提供了编辑器插件。

sents.zh: Flutter 提供了数以万计的软件包来加速你的开发，无论你的目标平台是什么。

sents.en: And accessing other native code is easy, with support for both FFI ( on Android , on iOS , on macOS , on Linux , and on Windows ) as well as platform-specific APIs .
sents.zh: 访问其他原生代码也很容易，既支持 FFI（在 Android、iOS、macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上），也支持特定于平台的 API。

paragraphs.en: Flutter is a fully open-source project, and we welcome contributions. Information on how to get started can be found in our contributor guide .
paragraphs.zh: Flutter 是一个完全开源的项目，我们欢迎贡献。 关于如何入门的信息，请参阅我们的贡献者指南。
